was: RV park at Netley Creek Golf Course in Petersfield, 25 minutes north of Winnipeg: about 115 full-hookup sites (water, hydro, sewer), most of them seasonal, with nightly, weekly and monthly stays on the rest; pool and splash pad, washrooms with showers, laundry, restaurant; open May 15 - Oct 15. --Claude  SEASONAL SHARE: 77 of the ~115 sites were built for seasonal campers; nightly stays share the other 38 ('limited spots'). --Claude  MINIMUM STAY: 2 nights on every stay (operator's rate page and Let's Camp, 2026-10-11). --Claude

was: Family campground on Jaggars Point at Smiths Cove near Digby, on the Annapolis Basin: about 38 nightly RV sites (15-amp water/electric, 30-amp water/electric and 30-amp full hookup) among ~80 seasonal lots, plus tent sites, cabins and a rental trailer; pool, mini golf, showers, laundry, WiFi, 2,500 ft of shore to walk. Book by request form or phone. --Claude  MINIMUM STAY: 2 nights on every stay (booking form, 2026-10-11). --Claude

was: Fishing camp on Red Gut Bay of Rainy Lake, ~30 mi E of Fort Frances off Hwy 11. RV/trailer sites with water and electric plus a modern shower house and freezer service; reservation-only; campsites C$270 a week (2026, plus 13% HST). The rates page's '4 Day minimum charge' is the cabins'. --Claude

was: A family-run campground since 1963 with about 200 RV and 50 tent sites on Stock Island, 5 miles from Duval Street. US callers book by phone and international guests by a request form; there is no online booking. Weekly stays may be required on some site types from Oct 15 to Apr 30. --Claude

was: Lake Minatare SRA's Butte View campground, 3 km east of Lake View across the lake, in the woods off the east-side park road: paved back-in electric plus sites, part bookable online, the rest first come. A wildlife refuge, closed to all public access October 15 - January 15. Park entry permit required. --Claude

was: Lake Ogallala SRA's West Campground, on the west shore of Lake Ogallala just below Kingsley Dam, with its own West Entrance off the Keystone road; across the lake from the East Campground. Basic grass sites off dirt and gravel lanes, spread about 2.3 km along the shore: a peninsula loop, a shore strip and a south loop; several RV sites sit right on the bank. No hookups; water at the fish-cleaning station, playground and south boat ramp. Pad lengths are not posted anywhere (2026-11-05); RVs are seen on the loops on imagery. Advance reservation only, like all Lake McConaughy/Ogallala camping. Park entry permit required. --Claude

was: Small campground near the upper (northwest) end of Calamus Reservoir, on its own road off the highway: one paved loop of electric pads under mature trees, set back from the boat ramp and parking lots; tent sites and designated parking-lot spots alongside. Shower house here; the park's dump station is at Little York Point. Park entry permit required. --Claude
